name: P_ResetJoyBindings
summary: Clears the joystick part of the binding profile: no device slots, every role reads the primary controller's own axis.
semantics: Clears the joystick part of the binding profile: no device slots, every role reads the primary controller's own axis. Answers int 0 at once. x3_src engine only (the original exes answer 0 without doing anything).
fl: absent from X3FL.exe; the x3_src engine adds it for both editions
notes: x3::input::resetJoystickBindings; takes effect at the next input poll. KC InputMapper calls it before it applies the profile lines d;<slot>;<device> and r;<role>;<source> (x3_src src/input/README.md, "Game controllers").

name: P_SetJoyDevice
summary: Puts a controller into a device slot: slot 1..
semantics: Puts a controller into a device slot: slot 1.. holds the device key "VVVV:PPPP" (vendor:product in hex, "#n" appended for the n-th of identical devices); device 0 or "" frees the slot. Answers 1 when the slot was set, 0 otherwise (bad slot or key). At once. x3_src engine only.
fl: absent from X3FL.exe; the x3_src engine adds it for both editions
notes: x3::input::setJoystickSlotDevice; takes effect at the next poll. The profile line d;<slot>;<device>.

name: P_GetJoyDevice
summary: The device key a slot holds ("VVVV:PPPP[#n]"), int 0 when the slot is free or out of range.
semantics: The device key a slot holds ("VVVV:PPPP[#n]"), int 0 when the slot is free or out of range. At once. x3_src engine only.
fl: absent from X3FL.exe; the x3_src engine adds it for both editions
notes: x3::input::joystickSlotDevice; an empty text answers int 0, as KC tests it (resumeBridgeText).

name: P_SetJoyRole
summary: Binds a joystick role to an axis: role 0..6 (stick X, stick Y, twist Z, twist Rz, rudder, throttle, hat) reads source "<device> <axis>" (the hat "<device> [number]"); source 0 or "" gives the role back to the primary controller's own axis.
semantics: Binds a joystick role to an axis: role 0..6 (stick X, stick Y, twist Z, twist Rz, rudder, throttle, hat) reads source "<device> <axis>" (the hat "<device> [number]"); source 0 or "" gives the role back to the primary controller's own axis. Answers 1 when set, 0 otherwise. At once. x3_src engine only.
fl: absent from X3FL.exe; the x3_src engine adds it for both editions
notes: x3::input::setJoystickRole; <device> is a slot number or device key as P_SetJoyDevice. Takes effect at the next poll. The profile line r;<role>;<source>; P_CaptureJoyAxis answers a source in this form.

semantics: The source of a role as the profile stores it ("<device> <axis>"), int 0 when the role reads the primary controller's own axis. At once. x3_src engine only.

semantics: What a role reads now, for the controls menu: "<device name>: <axis>", int 0 when it reads nothing. At once. x3_src engine only.

name: P_CaptureJoyAxis
summary: The controls menu's "move the axis": start 1 remembers the position of every axis and answers 0; later calls with 0 (one per frame) answer the axis moved most past half its range as a P_SetJoyRole source "<device> <axis>", int 0 while none has moved that far.
semantics: The controls menu's "move the axis": start 1 remembers the position of every axis and answers 0; later calls with 0 (one per frame) answer the axis moved most past half its range as a P_SetJoyRole source "<device> <axis>", int 0 while none has moved that far. semantics: The half extent Z of a bullet type (TBullets column, 16.16 multiples of the node size, as a script number): the radius of an expanding shell over its size, the thickness of a lightning arc. 0 for a type outside the bullet types. At once. x3_src engine only.

name: X2_GetStoryBuild
summary: Returns the build number of the story object a new game loads (0 if not found).
semantics: The build id of the story object a new game loads (x3story, or the -story command line object), read from its file; 0 when the file is not found. At once. x3_src engine only: in X3AP.exe the number 61 and in X3FL.exe 60 falls to the X2 dispatcher's default arm and answers int 0 (the original exes have no such name either). Used by the x3intro MainMenu version line.
fl: absent from X3FL.exe; the x3_src engine adds it for both editions (FL number 60)
notes: x3::script::SaveBuildBatch::build of g_startupResources.storyObject(Story). The main menu's version line (x3intro MainMenu). The number follows STA_LoadDIDSaveData, one lower in FL (FL has no X2_GetModName).

name: KN_GetSectorShipRadiusCandidates
args: ships:table, sectorContextId:int, originPosition:array, maxDistance:int | ships:table, sectorContextId:int, originPosition:array, maxDistance:int, requestedClass:int
summary: Returns ordered ship candidates for a positive search radius or a class-only search.
semantics: Returns ship object IDs in the table's iteration order. The optional class ID must be an integer. Zero applies no class filter. A positive ID must name a loaded class and matches it and its derived classes as numeric SE_IsClass does. With positive maxDistance, ships that pass the class check remain candidates when their positions cannot be safely used. When maxDistance is zero, a valid positive class ID requests class-only filtering and the origin and ship positions are not read. A negative distance, or zero without a positive class ID, returns int 0. An unsupported layout or other invalid query also returns int 0 so the caller can use the ordinary sector search. Answers at once.
fl: absent from X3FL.exe; the x3_src FL build registers it and returns int 0 without a matching layout
x3_src: new native in the SE dispatcher, available in the x3_src engine only
